title: SREV-020 GetFileName type output ABI shape

neither_io_shape.description: METHOD_NEITHER user buffers are original user-space virtual addresses; driver must probe, access in caller context or lock/map, and wrap probe + access in structured exception handling

probe_shape.description: ProbeForWrite is historical; ProbeForRead recommended; every user-buffer output requires a known byte length and exception-protected access

abi_mismatch_evidence.description: API_GET_FILE_NAME_ARGS declares type_buf as WCHAR*; public DLL header exposes the fourth SbieApi_GetFileName argument as ULONG*; the two declarations cannot share one slot safely

current_caller_state.description: All in-tree callers pass NULL for the fourth argument; no caller needs the type output

fail_closed_owner.description: Driver rejects non-NULL type_buf with STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER before any type-name write

future_abi_invariant.description: Future bounded API must add both a type buffer pointer and a type buffer byte length; the existing slot stays reserved

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: 4-byte non-NULL fourth argument fails closed without writing past the buffer; existing NULL-fourth-arg name queries still work

contracts: Driver must not invent a new ABI inside the old fourth-argument slot
Non-NULL type_buf returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER before any write
SbieApi_GetFileName(..., NULL) call sites remain valid
Probing objectType->Name.Length+sizeof(WCHAR) does not prove caller allocated to public ABI shape
